model_final_decision.method_summary: Optimized v-space multihead retrieval with 2D-view softmax, Gram-matrix norm computation, 4D broadcast p@G, in-place ops, and alpha=1.0 shortcut. Raw ratio improved from 0.491 to 0.463 (~5.7% faster). Key wins: 2D-view softmax dispatch and Gram norm approach.
model_final_decision.next_direction: Projections are the largest remaining cost (~40-50%). Next could explore fused projection layouts, better memory reuse, or stacked p@G approaches for high-L cases. Could also investigate PyTorch's linear vs matmul performance difference.

performance_caveat: Current initial recheck raw 0.4909365 and this method raw 0.4550456; previous same-track other-method observation 0.450881 is lower. Cross-run timing is noisy; no claim of unique global best or private clean revalidation.
